entities.name: Paul Roh Ki-nam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Paul Marie Kinam Roh was a Korean Catholic bishop who served as Apostolic Vicar of Seoul from 1940–1962 and Archbishop of Seoul from 1962–1967. He was noted as pro-American and anti-Communist in the Syngman Rhee years.
